empty.title: No payment terms

form.name: Name
form.typeHint: How payment timing is calculated. Net = fixed days after invoice. Due on Receipt = immediate. COD = pay on delivery. Proximate = due on a specific day of the month.
form.netDaysHint: Number of days after the invoice date when the full amount is due.
form.discountDaysHint: Number of days within which the buyer can pay to receive the early payment discount.
form.discountPercentBpsHint: Early payment discount in basis points. 100 BPS = 1%. Example: 200 = 2% discount.
form.priorityHint: Lower numbers appear first in dropdown lists.
